focus.jnote: The tape sits in wait-and-see mode into the decision. The dominant catalyst is the FOMC decision today, Wed 9/16 at 2:00 ET, where markets price a ~91% chance of a 25bp hike to 3.75–4.00% — what would be the first hike of 2026 — released with an updated SEP/dot plot, followed by Chair Warsh’s press conference at 2:30 ET; August Retail Sales landed at 8:30 ET. An oil-tinged tape stacked on a live rate decision this afternoon is not a premium-selling setup.
focus.notdown: Energy (XLE, XOM, MPC, OXY) and Defense (LMT, RTX, NOC) keep a structural oil/war-premium bid as WTI holds ~$105. But be honest: these are two-sided war trades, not clean Snipers — a Hormuz-easing or pipeline-restart headline (the Energy Secretary expects a restart soon) can gap energy straight back down. Watch-only, not table-pounders.
focus.notup: Semiconductors & AI names (NVDA, AMD, and the broad chip complex) remain the pressured group as higher yields hit credit-sensitive AI hyperscalers and rotation continues. But selling bear calls into an FOMC decision hours away carries violent-squeeze risk on any dovish surprise or hold — the disciplined answer is to sell nothing new today.

The one boarded name (BUG) is a same-day breakout with next-earnings N/A and OI unverified. Stand down on new credit spreads, or if you must be positioned, use short DTE that clears the 2:00 ET decision and cut size hard. Cash is a position today.
